offLabel.description: The text displayed within the InputToggle when it's off.

onLabel.description: The text displayed within the InputToggle when it's on.

width.description: Controls the width of the InputToggle element, in pixels. Increase it when custom labels do not fit.

onChange.description:
Called whenever the user toggles the component, in either direction. It is
given the event alone: unlike MUI's, it is not passed the new checked
state, which is read from the event's target instead.
